map.「按术式查询典型手术时长范围，支持多术式叠加估算与排台时间规划。」按输入参数进行: Looks up typical surgery duration ranges by procedure and supports stacked estimation across procedures and theatre scheduling; it computes from the inputs and outputs the result.
map.📖 查看「手术时长估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to surgery duration estimation
map.排台前将多个术式的最短时间/最长时间相加，得到整台手术的最短、预计与最长时长区间: Before scheduling, add the shortest and longest times of several procedures to get the minimum, expected and maximum duration range for the whole session, used for theatre scheduling and arranging the next case.
map.开启接台模式后，叠加每台术前准备、术后复苏与台间清洁时间（清洁只计 n−1 次）: With the sequential case mode on, add the pre-operative preparation, post-operative recovery and between-case cleaning time for each case (cleaning counted only n − 1 times), which is closer to the real occupancy.
map.在预计时长基础上预留 15% 缓冲（如接台合计 420 分钟留 63 分钟缓冲）: Reserve a 15% buffer on top of the expected duration (for example 63 minutes on a sequential total of 420 minutes) to absorb intra-operative variation and avoid delays between cases.
map.示例：两台手术 60–90 分与 120–180 分，接台准备 30 / 复苏: Example: two procedures of 60-90 min and 120-180 min, with 30 min preparation, 60 min recovery and 15 min cleaning between cases
map.时长合计 最短 180、预计 225、最长 270 分；接台耗时 = 30×2: Total duration: minimum 180, expected 225, maximum 270 minutes; sequential time = 30 × 2 + 60 × 2 + 15 × 1 = 195 minutes; total time: minimum 375 / expected 420 / maximum 465 minutes; the 15% buffer ≈ 63 minutes, giving about 483 minutes including the buffer (8 hours 3 minutes).
map.为什么用最短/预计/最长三段而非单一数值？: Why use minimum / expected / maximum instead of a single value?
map.手术时长受麻醉、粘连、出血量等影响波动大，给出区间比单点估计更稳妥，便于排台留余: Surgery duration varies widely with anaesthesia, adhesions, blood loss and other factors, so a range is more robust than a single point estimate and leaves room when scheduling.
map.清洁时间为什么只算 n−1 次？: Why is cleaning time counted only n − 1 times?
map.n 台手术之间有 n−1 个台间清洁间隔，首台前无需清洁、末台后由复苏衔接，因此: Between n procedures there are n − 1 cleaning intervals: no cleaning is needed before the first case, and after the last case recovery takes over, so between-case cleaning is counted only n − 1 times.
